open_points.subject: failed cleanup-record store call
open_points.text: If the store refused that record
open_points.question: Does “refused” mean every unsuccessful store call, only a typed repository refusal, or some other closed set of failures?
options: Every unsuccessful store call while writing the cleanup-failure record
Only an explicit typed refusal; persistence and transaction failures follow another path
Only persistence or transaction failure, since store operations do not have domain refusals
open_points.default_guess: Treat every unsuccessful store call while writing that record as the store failure described here.

open_points.subject: retry of an unrecorded function execution
open_points.text: the next start executes the element again
open_points.question: Is automatic start-up re-execution limited to run elements recoverable from a Run, or does it also cover admission and explicit-try executions; if it covers the latter, what durable fact identifies the implementation and trial case after their record write failed?
options: Only run elements are automatically recovered; admission is rerun on a later submission as A04 rule 2 states, and an explicit try is not automatically repeated
Every failed-to-record function execution, including admission and explicit try, is automatically repeated at the next start
Admission is automatically repeated, but explicit try is not
open_points.default_guess: Automatically recover only run elements; rerun admission only on a later submission and never repeat an explicit try without another request.

witness.initial: An implementation submission is running admission on a trial case; sandbox cleanup is unconfirmed and the store fails to write the TrialExecution with cleanup_failed.
events: The operator starts the kernel again, without submitting the implementation again.
outcomes: The changed State 5 passage makes the next start execute that trial element again.
A04 rule 2 says that after the restart a submission runs admission afresh, so no trial execution occurs until another submission.
witness.observer: The owner or agent inspecting trial executions before making another submission

open_points.subject: internal error during start-up recovery
open_points.text: answered and followed by the same end of the process
open_points.question: What happens when this store failure occurs during start-up recovery, before the surface opens and there is no request to answer?
options: Abort start-up and report the failure only to the host/operator
Open the surface long enough to return an internal-error response
Apply a separate start-up failure result while preserving the same retry semantics
open_points.default_guess: Abort start-up without opening the surface and report a sanitized start-up failure to the host/operator.

witness.initial: Start-up recovery re-executes a run's function element before the surface opens.
events: The caller's attempt to store the cleanup-failure NodeExecution fails.
outcomes: One implementation aborts start-up immediately because no request exists to answer.
Another implementation opens or retains the surface to manufacture the stated internal-error answer before stopping.
witness.observer: The host operator and clients attempting to connect during that start
